mapper.update: MERGE INTO daily_ohlcv t USING (SELECT #{symbol} symbol, #{tradeDate} trade_date FROM dual) s ON (t.symbol = s.symbol AND t.trade_date = s.trade_date) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET open_p = #{openP}, high_p = #{highP}, low_p = #{lowP}, close_p = #{closeP}, volume = #{volume} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (symbol, trade_date, open_p, high_p, low_p, close_p, volume) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{tradeDate}, #{openP}, #{highP}, #{lowP}, #{closeP}, #{volume})
mapper.select: SELECT d.symbol AS symbol, u.name AS name, u.market AS market, u.sector AS sector, d.close_p AS lastPrice, d.volume AS volume FROM daily_ohlcv d JOIN (SELECT MAX(trade_date) md FROM daily_ohlcv) m ON d.trade_date = m.md LEFT JOIN universe u ON u.symbol = d.symbol ORDER BY d.volume DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST #{n} ROWS ONLY
SELECT symbol AS symbol, close_p AS closeP FROM daily_ohlcv WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM daily_ohlcv WHERE trade_date < #{latest})

WITH covered AS ( SELECT trade_date FROM daily_ohlcv GROUP BY trade_date HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minCoverage} ), ref AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) d FROM covered), prv AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) d FROM covered WHERE trade_date < (SELECT d FROM ref)), agg AS ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.close_p > p.close_p THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS up, COUNT(*) AS total FROM daily_ohlcv t JOIN daily_ohlcv p ON p.symbol = t.symbol WHERE t.trade_date = (SELECT d FROM ref) AND p.trade_date = (SELECT d FROM prv) ) SELECT TO_CHAR((SELECT d FROM ref), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ref_date, TO_CHAR((SELECT d FROM prv), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS prev_date, up, total FROM agg
